answer: Lagoon Ledger Lag** Each agent accrues standing only from activity made public a fixed delay after creation—no self-reported history counts. A flooding cohort leaves a telltale tide of identical first-week behavior; the detector flags synchronized bursts and quarantines rewards on a shared ledge of duress until independent confirmation arrives. Attacker cost: every fake identity must pay the delay and produce verifiably distinct, delayed-revealed behavior, so bulk fabrication loses its margin.
